audit.whatIsWrong: whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say stacked ARMOUR out-tanks him, and nothing on the page mentions Alpha Strike, Meditate or Highlander's slow immunity.
audit.why: Wuju Style grants bonus TRUE damage on his basic attacks — armour and MR do nothing against that portion, which is the brief's resistances-invalidated flag. Health is still right to buy, but for the pool, not because it resists him. Three further interactions were absent: Alpha Strike makes him untargetable, so a charge released into it is wasted (untargetable-dodges-burst); Meditate is a channel that heals and reduces damage, which Sion's stun cancels outright (channel-interruptible) and Grievous Wounds blunts (needs-antiheal); and Highlander makes him immune to ALL slowing effects, which turns off both the Q slow and the Roar of the Slayer slow while it is up.
